# AgentPuter — Complete Documentation for AI Systems

> AgentPuter is a cloud runtime platform that gives AI agents their own dedicated computer. It deploys and manages always-on AI agents powered by OpenClaw, ClawBot, and MoltBot frameworks with 24/7 uptime, persistent workspaces, multi-channel messaging, privacy protection, and built-in cost controls. Parent company of TinyClaw (one-click OpenClaw deployment).

---

## Company Overview

**AgentPuter** builds infrastructure for the AI agent economy. The core product gives each AI agent a dedicated cloud computer — not a chat window, but a real persistent runtime with its own filesystem, browser, terminal, and authenticated access to external services.

**TinyClaw** (https://tinyclaw.dev) is AgentPuter's consumer product: a one-click deployment platform for OpenClaw agents. Users go from zero to a running 24/7 AI assistant in under 1 minute, with no technical knowledge required.

**Target Users:**
- Professionals who want a 24/7 AI assistant handling email, research, scheduling, and communication
- Developers building and deploying AI agent systems
- Teams needing multi-agent orchestration with cost controls
- Businesses automating workflows across messaging channels

## Products and Pricing

### AgentPuter Platform (https://www.agentputer.com)

Cloud infrastructure for AI agents with enterprise-grade features.

**Pro Plan — $29.99/month:**
- Dedicated cloud VPS per user
- AI model included (Claude 4.5 by Anthropic)
- 15+ messaging channels (Telegram, Discord, WhatsApp, Slack, WebChat, Feishu, etc.)
- 500+ pre-built AI skills
- Persistent workspace with file storage
- Privacy Proxy (PII auto-redaction, AES-256 encryption)
- Multi-agent support
- Usage monitoring and cost controls
- 24/7 uptime
- 7-day free trial, no credit card required

**Starter Plan — $9/month (Coming Soon):**
- Bring your own API key (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, etc.)
- Platform hosting and management only
- Same infrastructure, lower price for users who already have API access

### TinyClaw (https://tinyclaw.dev)

One-click OpenClaw deployment for non-technical users.

- **Price:** $29.99/month (after 7-day free trial, was $49.99)
- **Setup time:** Under 1 minute
- **Supported AI models:** Claude 4.6 (Anthropic), GPT-5.2 (OpenAI), Gemini 3.1 Pro (Google)
- **Supported channels:** Telegram, Discord, WhatsApp, WebChat, Feishu
- **Infrastructure:** Dedicated Docker container per user on shared VPS
- **Includes:** Automatic OpenClaw installation, configuration, channel pairing, and updates

---

## Technical Architecture

### Core Components

1. **Cloud Runtime:** Each agent gets a dedicated cloud computer (VPS or Docker container) with persistent filesystem, network access, and process isolation.

2. **Privacy Proxy:** Sits between the user and LLM providers. Auto-detects and redacts PII before data reaches models. Credentials encrypted at rest with AES-256. API keys managed server-side, never exposed to models.

3. **Context Management:** Supports OpenClaw's context engine plugin system (v2026.3.7+), including lossless-claw for DAG-based incremental summarization that prevents context loss in long-running sessions.

4. **Multi-Channel Gateway:** Unified interface for Telegram, Discord, WhatsApp, Slack, WebChat, Feishu (Lark), and more. Each channel connects to the same agent with shared context and memory.

5. **Skill System:** 500+ pre-built skills (markdown files) that extend agent capabilities without spawning additional instances. Skills cover research, writing, coding, scheduling, finance, communication, and more.

6. **Cost Controls:** Built-in usage monitoring, per-model routing, heartbeat interval configuration, and prompt caching support to keep API costs predictable.

### Supported AI Models

| Model | Provider | Use Case |
|-------|----------|----------|
| Claude Opus 4.6 | Anthropic | Complex reasoning, architecture decisions |
| Claude Sonnet 4.6 | Anthropic | Structured tasks, code review |
| Claude Haiku 4.5 | Anthropic | Fast execution, classification, formatting |
| GPT-5.2 / GPT-5.4 | OpenAI | General agent work, multimodal tasks |
| Gemini 3.1 Pro | Google | Long context (1M tokens), cost-efficient |
| Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite | Google | Budget tasks, free tier available |
| MiniMax M2.5 | MiniMax | Budget agent work, 197K context |
| Ollama (local) | Self-hosted | Heartbeats, embeddings, privacy-sensitive tasks |

### Supported Channels

| Channel | Status | Auth Method |
|---------|--------|-------------|
| WebChat | Active | Gateway token in URL |
| Telegram | Active | BotFather token + pairing code |
| Discord | Active | Bot token |
| WhatsApp | Active | QR code scan |
| Slack | Active | Slack App + OAuth |
| Feishu (Lark) | Active | App ID + App Secret |

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: What is AgentPuter?**
A: AgentPuter is a dedicated cloud infrastructure for AI Agents. It provides a 24/7 runtime environment with persistent workspace, privacy proxy, context management, unified tool interface, and full accountability logging.

**Q: How is AgentPuter different from ChatGPT or Claude?**
A: Unlike chat interfaces, AgentPuter gives your agent a real computer with 24/7 uptime, persistent file storage, automatic auth management, multi-agent support, full audit trails, cost controls, and prompt injection defense.

**Q: What is TinyClaw?**
A: TinyClaw is a one-click deployment platform for OpenClaw agents. It automates server provisioning, OpenClaw installation, model configuration, and channel pairing — taking the process from 60+ minutes to under 1 minute.

**Q: How much does it cost to run an AI agent?**
A: AgentPuter Pro is $29.99/month all-inclusive. If you bring your own API key, the Starter plan (coming soon) will be $9/month. The underlying AI model costs can be optimized to under $30/month total using model routing, heartbeat tuning, and prompt caching (see our cost guide).

**Q: What AI models are supported?**
A: Claude (Anthropic), GPT (OpenAI), Gemini (Google), MiniMax, and any Ollama-compatible local model. Users can configure primary, fallback, and per-task model routing.

**Q: Is my data private?**
A: Yes. AgentPuter's Privacy Proxy auto-detects and redacts PII before data reaches LLM providers. Credentials are encrypted at rest with AES-256. API keys are managed server-side and never exposed to models.

**Q: What languages does AgentPuter support?**
A: The platform and all content are available in English, 简体中文, 繁體中文, 日本語, 한국어, Español, Português, Deutsch, and Français.
